comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — Issue #⁠245596 reports the Shoper cookie-consent dialog on www⁠.4motos.pl ("Dbamy o Twoją prywatność") plus its dark page mask; the reporter profile reproduced both. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for the overlay and its mask was validated in the extension (symptom resolved, page integrity intact, no remaining instances), so I propose it for the Cookie Notices filter. ## Rule `4motos.pl##.consents__wrapper, .consents__mask` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance (a first-party Shoper consent dialog plus its page mask), which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter is meant to handle; the run instruction closes no rule category for it:⁠ it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall. No anti-adblock, malware or paywall policy rule applies; the page shows a plain consent overlay. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/9941b7d3307202ca616dd93a3e5bddd9e5997ffd/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40604415016 Automated analysis against filters at `9941b7d`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
